newsitem.title: UK: Libya likely to roll over crude prices for Sept.
newsitem.headline: Libya likely to roll over crude prices for Sept.

text.p: Libya's state-owned National Oil Company (NOC) has not yet published its official selling price for its crudes for September but is likely to roll them over from August, European traders said.
There has been no explanation for the delay by NOC in publishing its September prices, which had been expected by lifters in the last week of August.

If NOC does keep prices unchanged for September, it would leave Amna at Dated Brent -55 cents, Brega at Dated Brent +30 cents, Bouri at Iranian Heavy -30 cents, Es Sider at Dated -15 cents, Sarir at Dated Brent -50 cents, Sirtica at Dated -10 cents and Zueitina at Dated +30 cents.
The NOC rolled prices over from July into August.
